Therefore the relation is I_C ≤ β_dc I_B.

method.method_draft: First describe the figure as a BJT with labeled base current I_B, collector current I_C, and dc current gain beta_dc. From the text, use the given condition that the transistor is operating in saturation. Recall that beta_dc I_B is the collector current predicted only for active-region operation. In saturation, the actual collector current cannot exceed the active-region prediction for the applied base current, so conclude I_C <= beta_dc I_B.

method.method_draft: Inspect the figure to associate I_B with the base drive and I_C with the collector current. Use the text condition that the transistor is saturated.
